problem_statement: Demonstrate how one public-facility maintenance issue can be registered, assigned, paused and handed off without pretending that a real asset, operator or field result has been verified.

public_interest.intended_value: Make service responsibility and failure handling visible while preserving basic offline public service.
public_interest.distributional_test: Compare service continuity and burden for smartphone and non-smartphone users and record any group-specific worsening.
public_interest.non_worsening_rule: No group may lose an existing basic service because the digital layer is introduced, changed or removed.

place.name: Synthetic waterfront-facility record within the provisional northern concept area

permit_dependencies: waterfront and ecological review where relevant
electrical and network safety review where relevant

system.component: paper-first responsibility card with optional local duplicate-work-order clustering
system.abstention_rule: Return the record to a named maintainer whenever location, ownership, safety or fault classification is uncertain.
system.human_takeover: A frontline maintainer verifies the fault and an authorised asset owner decides closure, replacement or retirement.
system.offline_behaviour: Paper and phone work orders continue; lighting, physical wayfinding and staffed help do not depend on this digital record.

data_and_rights.purpose: Track a facility fault and its responsibility path, not user behaviour.
data_and_rights.notice_and_choice: A public notice and paper alternative are required before any real collection; this example collects no field data.
data_and_rights.retention: No operational retention applies to this synthetic record; a real pilot must set a purpose-limited period before authorisation.
data_and_rights.deletion_verification: A real operator must log deletion completion or the lawful reason for retention; no deletion claim is made here.
data_and_rights.content_rights: Original synthetic demonstration; no third-party photograph, audio, map tile or asset record is included.

human_gate.independent_reviewer_role: future reviewer independent of proposer and operator

decisions.decider_role: future asset, safety and waterfront professionals
decisions.decision_difference: No professional decision has been made.

decisions.decider_role: future affected-user and accessibility review panel
decisions.decision_difference: No affected-user review has been conducted.
No operational data processing has been authorised.

decisions.decider_role: future authorised asset owner and maintenance lead
decisions.decision_difference: No operator, service level or lifecycle budget has been confirmed.

responsible_role_slots: future data steward if a digital layer is used
operations.service_window: not set; must be agreed before an authorised baseline
operations.contact_path: proposed paper, phone and staffed channels; no real contact is asserted
operations.on_call_rule: safety-critical faults bypass AI and follow the authorised emergency path
operations.maintenance_cycle: to be set from verified asset criticality and manufacturer/owner requirements
spares_and_dependencies: unknown until an authorised asset inventory exists

evaluation.sample_frame: Synthetic one-record walkthrough only; the authorised baseline must first define the real asset universe and criticality classes.

metrics.definition: share of in-scope assets with verified owner, fallback, maintenance and retirement fields
metrics.candidate_threshold: 100% before limited trial for in-scope assets

metrics.definition: median elapsed hours from verified fault to verified service restoration
share of announced drills in which basic service and human control remain available

evaluation.uncertainty_note: There is no verified asset list, operator, baseline, sample or field result. Null values are intentional and prevent synthetic evidence from being mistaken for performance.
evaluation.review_cycle: 90-day authorised baseline, quarterly limited-trial review, annual public review and adopt/modify/pause/exit decision
